messages.content: I told my partner I needed space and now I feel bad about it.
Honestly, needing space isn't something to feel bad about - it's a normal request, not a rejection of them.
I guess I'm worried they took it the wrong way.
That's worth actually checking directly, honestly, rather than assuming - a quick 'hey, just want to make sure that landed okay' clears up a lot without over-explaining.
Yeah, I think I'll do that tonight.
Sounds good, honestly - and try not to over-apologize when you do, the request itself was reasonable.
